svg.title: tiny-reasoner — a language model built from scratch and taught to reason with GRPO
svg.desc: A 4.3 million parameter Llama-style language model written from scratch in PyTorch and trained on a 4-core CPU: it learns step-by-step arithmetic from worked solutions, then improves with GRPO reinforcement learning from right-or-wrong rewards. On held-out tests, 300 problems per level, 300 GRPO steps took level 5 from 52 to 96 percent, level 4 from 94 to 98 and level 3 from 96.7 to 99. Level 6, longer numbers never seen in training, stayed at 0 percent. From the same start, 1,500 more supervised steps reached 98.3 percent on level 5. Also: LoRA teaches long division with 5 percent of the weights, int8 quantization is 3.7 times smaller with the same accuracy, speculative decoding is up to 1.87 times faster, and a FastAPI app streams tokens. 41 tests and CI.
